svg.title: Figure GK-8. Blind spots around a tractor-trailer
svg.desc: Top view of a tractor-trailer pointing right. Shaded zones in front of the cab, along the left side near the door, a large zone along the right side, and behind the trailer show where mirrors cannot see.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure GK-8. Blind spots around a tractor-trailer

svg.text: • Shaded areas: blind spots your mirrors cannot show you. The right side is the largest.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • Check mirrors regularly, before and after you signal, and before lane changes and turns.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • Drop back or pull forward so other drivers can see you; avoid riding alongside others.
